mission_02: Excellent work! You have implemented SHAP values from first principles using Shapley value theory. Your implementation correctly computes the weighted marginal contributions of each feature across all possible coalitions, ensuring the efficiency property that SHAP values sum to the prediction difference from baseline. For a linear model, the SHAP values should closely match the true coefficients scaled by feature deviations from the mean. This brute-force approach is exact but exponential in complexity — production implementations like KernelSHAP use sampling approximations to handle high-dimensional data efficiently.
